_note: Curated list of well-known Telugu proverbs. The agent only explains proverbs from this list and never invents one. Please have a native speaker check the spelling and meanings, then set reviewed_by_native to true. Add more entries any time: proverb (exact Telugu text), meaning_en (what it literally says and means), lesson_en (the everyday takeaway).

items.meaning_en: The bird is small but its call is mighty. A small person can have great ability or presence.
items.lesson_en: Do not judge ability by size or age.

items.meaning_en: Delay turns nectar into poison. Even a good thing is spoiled if it is done too late.
items.lesson_en: Act on time; postponing good work wastes its value.

items.meaning_en: Digging up a mountain to catch a mouse. A huge effort that gives a tiny result.
items.lesson_en: Match the effort to the goal and plan before starting.

items.meaning_en: Steadiness is what matters most. Careful, patient progress beats hasty action.
items.lesson_en: Haste often causes mistakes; steady, thoughtful work lasts.

items.meaning_en: Grabbing leaves after the hands are already burnt. A remedy applied too late.
items.lesson_en: Prepare and prevent before trouble arrives.

items.meaning_en: Even God cannot catch the thief inside the house. It is very hard to guard against harm from someone within one's own circle.
items.lesson_en: Be careful whom you trust with access to what matters.

items.meaning_en: The grapes that are out of reach are sour. People run down what they cannot have.
items.lesson_en: Be honest with yourself and avoid belittling what you could not achieve.

items.meaning_en: Burning the raft after crossing the river. Forgetting or discarding the help that got you across once the need is over.
items.lesson_en: Remember and respect those who helped you.

items.meaning_en: If the yam itself does not itch, why should the cutting knife? Why worry about a matter when the person concerned does not mind.
items.lesson_en: Avoid needless worry and interfering in what is not your concern.

items.meaning_en: What does not bend as a sapling will not bend as a tree. Good habits and values are easiest to teach when young.
items.lesson_en: Build good habits early, in yourself and in children.

items.meaning_en: A tiny lamp gives a mountain of light. A small help or good deed can make a great difference.
items.lesson_en: Never think a small act of kindness is too small to matter.

items.proverb: తాను ఒకటి తలిస్తే దైవం ఒకటి తలుస్తుంది
items.meaning_en: One plans one thing, fate decides another. Results may differ from what we planned.
items.lesson_en: Plan well, work hard, and stay calm when outcomes differ.

items.meaning_en: The idle barber shaves the cat's head. People with nothing to do busy themselves with pointless things.
items.lesson_en: Keep yourself engaged in meaningful work.

items.proverb: ఇల్లు కట్టి చూడు, పెళ్లి చేసి చూడు
items.meaning_en: Build a house and see; arrange a wedding and see. Some tasks show their true difficulty only when you do them yourself.
items.lesson_en: Respect the effort behind big undertakings before judging them.

items.meaning_en: Hunger knows no taste. When truly hungry, any food is welcome; need overrides choosiness.
items.lesson_en: Gratitude for what we have, and empathy for those in real need.

items.meaning_en: One does not understand until it comes to oneself. We grasp another's hardship only when we face it ourselves.
items.lesson_en: Practice empathy before you have to learn it the hard way.

items.meaning_en: Excess is to be avoided everywhere. Too much of anything, even a good thing, causes harm.
items.lesson_en: Seek balance and moderation in everything.
